speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The pudding is the last of the dish. Eat it while it is hot. I am not reheating a dinner for a man who has already had his plot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will do. I am not bringing the page down to sweeten it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The light is up in the yard. I can see the kennel from the bench, and the frost is only in the shade now. I go when this is finished. Norton Folgate does not wait on pudding.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will clear when the bowl is empty. The sand is in the box, sir. I am not bringing the box to the table to be told a second time.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One bowl. When it is done, the table is a table again. I have had my one question of the morning, and I am spending it on this.
